mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO contractor_likes (user_id, contractor_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{contractorId})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM contractor_likes WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND contractor_id = #{contractorId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM contractor_likes WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND contractor_id = #{contractorId}

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.company_name, c.career, c.preferred_types, c.service_area, c.introduction, c.portfolio_images, c.average_rating, c.review_count, u.nickname, u.profile_image FROM contractor_likes l JOIN contractors c ON c.id = l.contractor_id JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id WHERE l.user_id = #{userId} AND c.is_banned = 0 ORDER BY l.created_at DESC
